details.description:
World’s favourite M&M’s chocolate candies, a treat for all candy and chocolate bar lovers, are now in India. Deliciously smooth and sweet milk chocolate coated in fun coloured shells is what best defines M&M’s flavourful candy pops. With loads of happy colours to choose from, M&M chocolate candies are the best kind of snacks to unlock some fun and brighten up any situation. 
These round lentils-shaped candies can be used to make your candy buffets and sweet dishes more colourful. Make M&M's milk chocolate candies a part of any baking recipes to make fun chocolate treats. You can also add these chocolate gems to make fun and delicious party favours and gift boxes. Each piece of the smooth and chocolatey M&M’s, in a colourful sugar shell, gives you a reason to celebrate the little moments in life. Share the love of M&M’s Candy with your friends, family or feature them in a colourful bake, to add a pop of fun, colours and taste to brownies, cookies and more. Share a box of M&M's milk chocolate candies with your loved ones and experience the joy for yourself!
details.ingredients: Sugar, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifiers (E422, E322, E476), Flavour (Natural Vanilla)

details.description:
We are at our happiest while sharing a laugh and making real connections with other people. M&M’s candy lets you share fun, meaningful moments and lighten up the world with a bit of enjoyment. 
M&M’s chocolate coated peanuts in colourful shells can lift the spirit by brightening any situation. These perfect round bite-size lentil candies can be used to make your candy buffets and sweet dishes turn into a colourful treat to be shared with everyone! The peanut crunch of the M&M candies is like a cherry on the top, that can be shared with guests. 
Each piece of the smooth and chocolatey M&M’s, in a colourful sugar shell, gives you a reason to celebrate the little moments of life. Indulge in some playful wittiness with M&M’s.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Peanuts, Cocoa Mass, Milk Solids (Full Cream Milk Powder, Lactose), Cocoa Butter, Starch, Palm Fat, Glucose Syrup, Shea Fat, Stabiliser (Gum Arabic (E414), Colours (Curcumins (E133), Carotenes (E160a), Beta-Apo-8'-Carotenal (E160e), Beetroot Red (E162), Titanium Dioxide (E171), Iron Oxides And Hydroxides (E172), Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin (E322), Dextrin, Glazing Agent (Carnauba Wax (E903), Palm Kernel Oil, Salt, Natural Vanilla Extract.
